fields.label: Dealer ID
fields.description: Qaysi filialning (Report Service Dealer Branch) o'z feedidagi clientCid ekanligi -- islagan filial (bosh diler yoki sub-filial) bo'lishi mumkin, is_main bilan bog'liq emas. clientCid raqamlanishi har bir dealerId uchun mustaqil, shuning uchun aynan shu dealerId+clientCid kombinatsiyasi kerak.
